description: Prepare leaving a loan to roll over by itself: gage's keeper rolls it in its last hours into a loan of the same size and term, at most maxCost each, up to four times. Leaves standing approvals to gage's rollover router. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

engine.description: The engine; the current core when omitted, the loan's own core for a loan in a lend asset

maxCost.description: The most each new loan may cost, its fixed cost and origination fee together, raw units of the loan's asset, at most the loan's principal; when omitted, twice what a roll of the loan costs now, held to four times the loan's own cost and fee (a listing not funded yet: twice its own cost and fee)

name: gage_prepare_auto_roll
title: Prepare: Roll a loan over by itself
